# Quantum Order Entanglement

This repository asks which coherent permutations of independent identical
quantum channels can generate entanglement between the retained order controller
and target. Its complete scientific account is organized by topic under science/.

Canonical entrypoints:
- README.md: question, principal results, science and study routes, reproduction
  commands, scope, purpose and contact.
- science/README.md: connected reading route and claim-to-proof map.
- science/model.md: independent identical slots, chronological permutations,
  Kraus-basis independence, input quantifiers and supplied resources.
- science/order_criterion.md: reference-relative group, the exact universal
  nonentangling criterion, product-Kraus proof and minimum-order consequences.
- science/channel_realizations.md: inherited conditional-unitary commutation
  lemma, fixed n+2-dimensional marker channel, unconditional NPT converse,
  and the separate exponential-dimension complete-erasure construction.
- science/qubit_example.md: measure-Z/prepare-X entanglement-breaking channel,
  full channel-square identity, exact 3x2 output, rational witness and local filter.
- science/robustness.md: specified controller-dephasing/output-white-noise family,
  exact separability threshold, fixed-witness threshold and output-distance bound.
- science/interpretation.md: channel-specific obstructions, distinct operational
  tasks, resource accounting and the scientific meaning of the criterion.
- references/RELATED_WORK.md: inherited ingredients, closest inspected work,
  source locations and boundaries of the contribution.
- references/references.bib: primary research records and the educational anchor.
- verification/README.md: commands, expected outputs and verification limits.
- verification/verify_exact.py: standard-library exact finite certificates.
- verification/verify_marker.py: numerical marker checks for three and four slots.

Learning entrypoints:
- learning/MILESTONES.md: the common project-defined map, exactly M01 through M30,
  with background/preliminaries followed by narrative/innovation, dependencies,
  understanding targets, conceptual connections and scientific source pointers.
- learning/WATROUS_BRIDGE.md: the single educational anchor, John Watrous's
  The Theory of Quantum Information (2018), its verified section pointers,
  notation translations and the locally supplied steps into this project.

Reader routes:
- For the scientific story, begin with the model, follow the criterion and
  channel realizations, inspect the qubit example, and join the conclusions
  in the interpretation. Read robustness for the exact stated noise family.
- For self-directed study, use the bridge beside the milestone map and follow
  each milestone's canonical references. The map is common to every reader.
- For theorem review, read the model and the complete iff statement first,
  then both the product-Kraus proof and the faithful channel realization.
  Check the primary-source attribution of the conditional-unitary lemma.
- For a concrete witness, read the qubit output and partial-transpose certificate
  before running the exact verification program.
- For reproduction, use the documented commands from the repository root.
  Distinguish a new successful execution from an earlier recorded result.

Essential distinctions:
- The tensor order is C tensor T. Entanglement concerns the retained controller
  and target, not the target and an untouched reference after discarding C.
- A chronological permutation lists the first slot first; its Kraus product
  acts on a state from right to left. Environmental tuples label physical slots.
- The relative group is generated by pi0^{-1} pi. Its abelian property is
  independent of the reference. It concerns order permutations, not target gates.
- Abelian support gives a product-Kraus joint channel for every finite-dimensional
  identical channel, preserving every separable input. The converse supplies
  an explicit channel for each nonabelian support and every full-support pure
  controller; it does not say that every noise model entangles.
- The necessity statement is about pure occupied control support. Arbitrary
  mixed-controller necessity and a fixed-target-dimension classification are
  outside the theorem.
- One marker channel fixed by n works for every nonabelian support at that n
  on target dimension n+2. Its marker probability is not an entanglement amount.
  Its output is already NPT before the optional local marker projection.
- The shift/reset channel separately gives complete definite-order erasure at
  target dimension s^n. Do not combine that resource bound with the marker's
  linear target dimension as though one construction established both.
- The marker and shift/reset channels are not entanglement breaking. The minimal
  qubit example is entanglement breaking and attains three calls, three coherent
  alternatives and target dimension two. A common final EB slot obstructs an
  EB-only universal converse even when the relative group is nonabelian.
- The local filter in the qubit example succeeds with probability one half and
  exposes a mixed entangled two-qubit state, not a pure Bell pair.
- The exact dephasing threshold applies to rho_eta = eta rho + (1-eta) I_6/6.
  The exact transition, the fixed rational witness threshold and the conservative
  trace-norm radius are different statements. They do not characterize arbitrary
  errors in the individual channel slots.
- NPT implies entanglement in all finite dimensions. General dimension-based
  PPT sufficiency is used only in 2x2 and 2x3. The inherited conditional-unitary
  family has its own special commuting iff separable, otherwise NPT criterion;
  a numerical PPT observation alone does not prove a general state separable.
- Ideal coherent order control is supplied. Each branch visits every independent
  slot once, with inaccessible environments, no intermediate target gates and
  no target-carrying bypass. Count the full target Hilbert-space dimension.
- The results do not assert a communication-capacity advantage, an advantage
  over unrestricted controlled circuits, or device-independent causal certification.
- Kraus freedom and the conditional-unitary commutation criterion are inherited.
  Read the attribution before characterizing the new architecture theorem.
- Analytical proofs support the universal statements. Exact finite certificates
  and numerical instances check particular ingredients and conventions.
- The selected textbook supplies foundations. The bridge identifies local
  explanations and research-level dependencies; primary research sources are
  not additional educational anchors.

Shared physical-noise route:
- science/noisy_separation.md: authoritative complete uniform CT-separability / accepted RT-NPT proof; raw tilted EB family, physical noise, both protocols, three encodings, 249 CT+83 RT exact grid obligations, continuity and charged costs.
- verification/audit_verify.py --root verification/certificates --rebuild: complete independent shared-certificate and polynomial rebuild.
- Sister foundation and optimization: https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Quantum-Order-Distillation/blob/main/science/noisy_routing_model.md ; science/controller_optimization.md ; science/recovery_frontier.md ; science/tilted_readout.md in that repository.

The separation holds for |delta|<=.2 radians; the sister tilted-optimality interval is |tan(delta/2)|<=1/5. CT positivity is strict only on occupied six-dimensional support. Protocols have different calls, controller bits, bipartitions and conditioning; this is not a universal retained-protocol no-go or optimized equal-resource separation. Arbitrary-controller Bell fidelity<=1/2 does not classify all outputs as separable. Both projects use Watrous as their sole educational anchor and keep exactly30 distinct project-defined milestones each.
